profiles.description: Telemetry SQLite aggregation performance across 10k and 100k events

profiles.verdict_reason: SQLite indexed aggregation takes < 3ms on 10k window and ~18ms on full 100k group-by. In-memory 3s/5s cache reduces warm dashboard queries to < 0.01ms. Porting to Rust would introduce FFI overhead without measurable latency reduction.

profiles.description: Subprocess creation vs streaming pipe throughput on Windows
